## What and why

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated, including failure paths
- [ ] `pnpm smoke` run if `package.json`, exports, or the build changed
- [ ] ADR added if this changes a design decision
- [ ] No secrets in logs, errors, or tool output
- [ ] README/docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] PR title is `type: summary` (e.g. `feat: add body-cursor pagination`)
